expression:
local({
  x <- coalesce(as.numeric(pubrtyb), as.numeric(pubrty), as.numeric(pubrtyc))
  male <- modal_within(recode_values(as.numeric(zf02m1), 1 ~ "Male", 2 ~ "Female", default = NA_character_), hicid) %in%
    "Male"
  skin <- as.numeric(hs36a) %in% 1:4
  odour <- as.numeric(hs36b) %in% 1:4
  hair <- as.numeric(hs36c) %in% 1:4
  breast <- as.numeric(hs36d) %in% 1:4
  spurt <- as.numeric(hs36e) %in% 1:4
  voice <- as.numeric(hs36f) %in% 1:4
  facial <- as.numeric(hs36g) %in% 1:4
  menses <- as.numeric(hs36h) %in% 1:2 | as.numeric(hs36c10) %in% 1:2
  share <- case_when(
    .wave == "3.5" & male ~ ((as.numeric(hs36ai) %in% 1:4) +
      (as.numeric(hs36ci) %in% 1:4) +
      (as.numeric(hs36ei) %in% 1:4) +
      (as.numeric(hs36fi) %in% 1:4) +
      (as.numeric(hs36gi) %in% 1:4)) /
      5,
    .wave == "3.5" ~ ((as.numeric(hs36ai) %in% 1:4) +
      (as.numeric(hs36ci) %in% 1:4) +
      (as.numeric(hs36di) %in% 1:4) +
      (as.numeric(hs36ei) %in% 1:4)) /
      4,
    !is.na(pubrtyb) & male ~ (skin + hair + spurt + voice + facial) / 5,
    !is.na(pubrtyb) ~ (skin + hair + breast + spurt + menses) / 5,
    !is.na(pubrty) & male ~ (skin + odour + hair) / 3,
    !is.na(pubrty) ~ (skin + odour + hair + breast) / 4,
    male ~ (skin + hair + spurt) / 3,
    .default = (skin + hair + breast + spurt + menses) / 5
  )
  if_else(x >= 1 & share >= 0.5, x, NA_real_)
})
notes: The study's released puberty scale (pubrtyb, K waves 3.5-8 and B waves 6-8; pubrty K wave 3, pubrtyc B wave 5), the mean of the answered sex-specific items scored 1-4 (observed 1-4; a yes to the menstruation item scores 4 and a no is left out of the mean), higher = more advanced. Used only where at least half the sex-specific items are answered (589 scores set to NA, 566 of them at wave 8, where many items carry a missing code): pubrtyb boys skin, body hair, growth spurt, voice and facial hair (hs36a, hs36c, hs36e, hs36f, hs36g; at wave 3.5 hs36ai, hs36ci, hs36ei, hs36fi, hs36gi), girls skin, body hair, breast growth, growth spurt and menstruation (hs36a, hs36c, hs36d, hs36e, and hs36h or hs36c10; at wave 3.5 hs36ai, hs36ci, hs36di, hs36ei, no menstruation item); pubrty skin, body odour and body hair, plus breast growth for girls (hs36a-hs36d); pubrtyc skin, body hair and growth spurt, plus breast growth and menstruation for girls. Sex from zf02m1, modal within child. Items identified from the released means; informant not documented in the supplied files.
